text.title: Carrot On A Stick
text.declared_mood: Cynical, confrontational, darkly sarcastic, oppressive, accusatory
text.production_notes: Dark minor piano loop, distorted industrial textures and metallic hits, sliding 808s with heavy sub and saturation, rapid hi-hat triplets and stutters, occasional beat dropouts before punchlines, hook hits with extra 808 distortion and layered chant vocals, ticking-clock percussion element
text.vocal_notes: Aggressive industrial trap delivery with gritty distortion, rapid triplet flows in verses, sarcastic spoken lines between bars, chant-style hook with layered gang vocals, occasional whispered lines before beat drops, ad-libs (Facts! / Pull! / Damn! / Why? / Look! / Huh!)
